title: Wyn's Park Party
markdown:
Teacher May smiled at the circle on the grass. “Good morning, everyone. Wyn Goose has a special announcement.”

Otis the otter stopped juggling pebbles. One pebble rested in his paw like a held breath. Sunny the puppy looked up from a butterfly that had been tasting a daisy.

Wyn Goose puffed out his chest until his white feathers shone. “Friends, we are having a meeting to make our park even more fun.”

Otis tilted his whiskers. “When is it, Wyn?”

Wyn tilted his head and thought of the sky. “When the sun is highest, and it is the first day of the week.”

Teacher May nodded, kind as a lunch-bell. “That’s noon on Monday.”

Wyn nodded too. “Yes. We’ll ask what games you love. Maybe a bouncy slide, or a splash-ball pond.”

“Splash-ball,” Sunny yipped, and did a happy dance that made the butterfly lift and settle again.

Otis wiggled from nose to tail. “Wonderful ideas, Wyn.”

Wyn beamed. “Hooray for the park.”

They sat a moment longer in the warm grass. Otis stacked his pebbles into a tiny tower. Sunny watched the daisy. Teacher May wrote noon on Monday on a scrap of paper so the highest sun would not have to explain itself twice.

A meeting works best when everyone knows the when, and the park listens better when it hears what the games are for. Who will bring the first splash-ball, do you suppose, when Monday’s sun stands still overhead?
characters: Otis (pebble-juggling otter), Sunny (butterfly-watching puppy), Teacher May (smiling class teacher)
